title: ProductSecurity
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Security viability dimension. Defines the property vocabulary for security governance: transport security, authentication, encryption, data classification. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms and as data type for Effectors/Receptors carrying security posture state. Source framework: TOGAF (Security Architecture) + ISO/IEC 25010 (Security sub-characteristic). Note: regulation-specific security requirements (GDPR, NIS2) are sourced from dedicated framework qualities — this archetype covers TOGAF's architecture-level security vocabulary.

tlsEnabled.description: Whether TLS is enabled for in-transit communication.

authenticationRequired.description: Whether authentication is required for access.

dataClassification.description: Data sensitivity classification level (ascending: PUBLIC < INTERNAL < CONFIDENTIAL < RESTRICTED). Drives encryption, access control, and audit requirements.
